annotations.title: Set the questions a track's sheet asks

description: Replaces the questions in the track's To do tab (call get_questions first to keep the ones it has). Each is {id, prompt, type, options, target, group, context, to, for}; any of them can be a sheet formula starting with =, so the sheet decides when to ask (a formula giving an empty prompt asks nothing) and where the answer goes. Answers already given stay in their rows, so keep a question's row when changing it. Formulas can't use IMPORT functions, IMAGE, HYPERLINK or WEBSERVICE.

questions.description: The whole list, 0 to 100, one row each in order. An empty list removes them all.

context.description: Details shown with it: text, or a range.

for.description: Who should answer it, names or roles comma separated. Empty: anyone on the sheet.

group.description: Questions with the same group show together.

id.description: Stays the same while it's the same question, so an answer stays with it. Often a formula from the row it's about.

options.description: The choices, comma separated, or a range like Categories!A2:A.

prompt.description: What it asks, like =IF(Transactions!G5="", "Which category is "&Transactions!C5&"?", "").

target.description: The cell the answer goes in, like Transactions!G5. Empty: the row's own answer column.

to.description: For reply: who it answers, an address or a cell holding one.

type.description: notice, confirm, choose, multi_choose, text, number, date or reply.
